headline: THE 195 LAKE VIEW INSPECTION IS RUNNING RIGHT NOW — ShowingTime confirmed it in writing at 7:46 this morning for noon today, and the MLS line on that same notice flipped to CONTINGENT. That is the last real contingency on your cleanest file, and nothing is owed by your side going into it. ⭐ THE OTHER LIVE THING ON THIS BOARD IS A PHONE CALL, NOT A SHOWING: 198 Rena's buyer agent left a SECOND voicemail at 10:50 asking you for a counter number and naming his own ceiling out loud — a buyer who volunteers his ceiling is negotiating with himself, and your sellers have now been silent on a live written offer for more than a day.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE BUYER'S AGENT ASKED FOR A COUNTER — OUT LOUD, TWICE. Jay G. left a second voicemail at 10:50 this morning asking what number your sellers want back, and named his buyer's ceiling himself while doing it. ⭐ That is offer intent stated without being asked for, on a house his buyer has already walked twice. ⚠️ It is a POSITION, not a receipt — nothing is on paper — and your sellers have been silent on the live written offer for more than a day.
hotSignals.action: Get a number back to him today, even a soft one. Silence on a second ask is how a buyer who is bidding against himself talks himself back down. ✅ Already on your call list — the milestone engine updated that task in place this morning rather than creating a twin, so there is exactly one chip for it.

hotSignals.signal: Mallory W. · ARC Realty Vestavia filed interested YES · priced JUST RIGHT · "Client loves the space and the fact that it has room for washer and dryer" — and phoned three minutes earlier to say her client "really, really liked it" and "wants to put an offer in" but needs to save a little more for the down payment, asking to be told if any other offer arrives. ⭐ STILL THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES ON THE BOARD. ✅ She returned your call at 6:00 Tuesday evening with a self-declared twenty-five-minute window, so the relationship is live. She has since put in writing exactly what her buyer needs help with.
hotSignals.action: Call her — and understand that the phone is now the ONLY channel: machine outreach to buyer's agents is suspended by your own Monday ruling until the send-safety ledgers are restored, so nothing will go out for you here. The question is what specifically gets her buyer to the table: timing, possession, or help at closing. She asked to be warned about competition, which means she intends to compete.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE PRICE MOVED AND THE MARKET ANSWERED THE SAME AFTERNOON. The MLS line read $299,000 in Monday night's seller report; Tuesday's 1:50 PM notice reads $295,000 · ACTIVE on the same MLS ID — and that notice IS a booking, Thursday 8/6 at 11:00 AM, the first fresh appointment this listing has taken since three separate buyers said the number was wrong. ⭐ Sequence, not proven causation, but it is the sequence you wanted.
hotSignals.action: Tomorrow morning is the test of whether the cut bought real traffic or one curious agent. Chase the feedback within the hour of the 11:00 tour — it is the single most informative read you will get this week.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE BUYER SIDE CALLED TO ASK ABOUT COMPETING OFFERS. An assistant to the agent who showed it Monday evening asked at 8:30 that night whether any offers are in or expected. ⭐ Agents do not ask that about houses their buyers are lukewarm on. ⭐ The sellers' own doorbell camera corroborates it — the mother was heard saying she loved it repeatedly and talking about the grass. ⚠️ STILL UNANSWERED on day three, and it is the only live buyer thread on a listing taking a tour a day.
hotSignals.action: Answer it today, honestly, in either direction. "No offers yet" is a perfectly good answer and it forces a decision; silence just lets them drift to the next house.

upcoming: 🔴 HAPPENING NOW — Wed 8/5 12:00 PM — 195 LAKE VIEW CIRCLE, Riverside. Have both answers ready before either seller calls you tonight.

⚠️ THAT IS THE ENTIRE FORWARD CALENDAR — one inspection running now and one showing tomorrow. Every other confirmed appointment in the fourteen-day window has already run, and nothing new was booked this morning. ⭐ WHICH MEANS THE LISTINGS CARRYING LIVE INTEREST — Rena, Altamont and Comanche — all need a PHONE CALL rather than a booking. Nothing on this board converts itself between now and Thursday morning.
